name: mcp.calendar.update
rests_on: agents-calendar CLI update VEVENT; extra argv is href etag then optional fields; dtstart and dtend prefer local wall time plus an optional IANA timezone (explicit timezone, else CALDAV_TIMEZONE or timezone in the credentials file, else the calendar's CalDAV calendar-timezone, else the host zone, else UTC); Z and numeric offsets stay absolute; all-day edits are YYYY-MM-DD with an exclusive dtend; a DST gap or ambiguous naive time errors, retry that instant with an explicit offset; exit 0 = updated

dtstart.description: Optional new start as local wall time (2026-11-29T16:00:00). Do not convert that wall time to UTC first. Z or a numeric offset is an absolute instant. All-day: YYYY-MM-DD (dtend exclusive). A gap or ambiguous time returns an error; retry that instant with an explicit offset.

dtend.description: Optional new end, same rules as dtstart. All-day dtend is exclusive.

timezone.description: Optional IANA zone for naive wall times, for example Europe/Berlin. When omitted: CALDAV_TIMEZONE or timezone in the credentials file, then the calendar's CalDAV calendar-timezone, then the host zone, then UTC.
